name: petroleum-teaching-atlas
description: Buildless static teaching site; npm dependencies are for DOM regression checks only.

scripts.build: node tools/build-m1-case.cjs && node tools/build-mudlogging-cases.cjs && node tools/build-drilling-lessons.cjs && node tools/build-welllog.cjs
